event.title: Trump Delays New Tariffs on Canada Amid Ongoing Negotiations
event.canonical_title: Trump Delays New Tariffs on Canada Amid Ongoing Negotiations
event.summary: President Trump has paused the implementation of new tariffs on Canada for 72 hours while negotiations continue. Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney indicated that significant discussions have taken place, but he noted that 'important work' remains to be done.

timeline.title: Canada to Announce Retaliatory Tariffs Against US
timeline.summary: Canada is set to announce retaliatory tariffs against the United States, according to an official familiar with the plans. This decision marks an escalation in a trade dispute that has intensified following the collapse of negotiations with the Trump administration.
key_facts: Canada will announce retaliatory tariffs against the US
The announcement is scheduled for Tuesday.
The trade dispute has worsened since negotiations with the Trump administration collapsed.
